enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back in bed. Pull blanket up to chest. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Place hand under pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm to side. Turn back to left. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Remain still. Snore. Move leg. Turn to back. Pull blanket over shoulders.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face with water. Pick up towel. Dry face. Apply soap to hands. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out cereal box. Take out bowl. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Close drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up bowl. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Check appearance. Pick up bag.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Attend morning meeting. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Wash hands. Check patient vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Update records. Walk to next patient. Assist with procedure. Sterilize equipment. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend afternoon meeting. Complete paperwork. Clock out.
Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Fill pot with water. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Stir pot. Turn off stove. Pour soup into bowl. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Pick up bowl. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Watch video. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Turn off TV. Close laptop. Stand up. Stretch.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Turn to right side. Move arm. Remain still. Snore. Turn to back. Pull blanket up.
